device_entry.name: JULABO F32-HD循环冷却器
tags: 环境控制与稳定性测试
device_entry.description: JULABO F32-HD 是一款实验室循环冷却器/恒温设备，通过循环冷却液为外部仪器或实验装置提供稳定的温度控制，适用于需要持续散热和恒温运行的实验系统。
device_entry.description_en: The JULABO F32-HD is a laboratory recirculating chiller/thermostatic unit that provides stable temperature control to external instruments or experimental setups by circulating coolant. It is used in lab systems that require continuous heat removal and controlled operating temperature.
